_comment_more: This should be merged into your ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json file

@khentertainment/kingcrab-plugin._enabled_comment: Enable or disable the KingCrab plugin

config._daemonUrl_comment: URL of the KingCrab daemon HTTP API
config._use_unix_comment: For production, use Unix socket: http+unix://%2Fvar%2Frun%2Fkingcrab.sock
config._token_comment: Shared secret for daemon authentication (if enabled)
config._retry_comment: Number of retries on connection failure
config._commands_comment: Default allowed commands for this plugin instance
config._note: Can be overridden by daemon config
config._reason_comment: Require reason for requests from this plugin

notifications._enabled_comment: Send Telegram notifications for new requests
notifications._userId_comment: Default Telegram user ID to notify (overrides per-request)

config._webhook_comment: Webhook URL for daemon to notify plugin of status changes
config._webhookSecret_comment: Shared secret for webhook signature validation

env._comment: Override daemon URL via environment if needed
env._comment2: Override daemon token via environment if needed

config._defaultReason_comment: Default reason template if not provided
config._showResults_comment: Show command execution results in chat
config._truncateOutput_comment: Truncate output to this many characters

telegram._comment: KingCrab can send inline buttons for approval

capabilities._inlineButtons_comment: Enable inline buttons for KingCrab requests

logging._level_comment: Log level: trace, debug, info, warn, error
